hook: Unconditional integer factorization in subexponential time.

beats.say: The paper gives a complete, unconditional factorization method with effectively computable constants and no unproven assumptions, and every prime factor is certified deterministically.
It also includes a complete formalization in Lean four, using only Mathlib, to be released in a companion submission.
The paper and its formalization were obtained by Cogentic, an agentic framework for mathematical discovery, using Gemini four as the base model.
